caption:
Vladimiros Tziortzis has wrapped up his 2026 NASCAR Euro Series season in the top five. 🏁

The Cypriot driver finished fifth in the EuroNASCAR OPEN standings, and his Ford Mustang, which he raced in both divisions, ended the year third in the Endurance Teams standings.

His podiums came at Paul Ricard in May and Vallelunga in September, and the season closed at Zolder in Belgium last weekend.

What should he aim for next year? 🇨🇾
